        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right
        self.random = random

def cloneTree(root):
    if not root:
        return None
    
    # Create a mapping from original nodes to their clones
    node_map = {}
    
    def clone_node(node):
        if not node:
            return None
        if node in node_map:
            return node_map[node]
        clone = TreeNode(node.val)
        node_map[node] = clone
        clone.left = clone_node(node.left)
        clone.right = clone_node(node.right)
        clone.random = clone_node(node.random)
        return clone
    
    return clone_node(root)
